map.综合税费率 = 增值税率 ×(1+附加合计率)，如 9%×(1+12%) = 1: Combined tax and surcharge rate = VAT rate × (1 + total surcharge rate), e.g. 9%×(1+12%) = 10.08%

map.城建税率怎么选？: How Do You Choose the Urban Construction Tax Rate?
map.按工程所在地：市区 7%、县城/镇 5%、其他 1%；教育费附加统一 3%、地方: By project location: city 7%, county town 5%, other 1%; the education surcharge is a uniform 3% and the local education surcharge is 2% in most regions (follow local rules), so the combined rate moves with the urban construction tax rate.
map.综合税费率 10.08% 怎么来的？: Where Does the 10.08% Combined Rate Come From?
map.增值税率 9% 本身，附加税费以增值税为基数再征 (7+3+2)%=12%，故: On top of the 9% VAT rate, surcharges are levied on the VAT base at (7+3+2)% = 12%, so 9%×(1+12%) = 10.08%; this is the combined tax burden relative to the pre-tax cost.
